sermons.title: Ephesians 6:16
sermons.description: Expository ministry on Ephesians 6:16, preached at Grace Chapel on Sunday 25th October 2026 by John Antalika. The Christian must remember he is a soldier in a battle, and needs to fend off attacks of Satan. But God hasn't left the Christian to do this alone, He has provided armour for all believers, and this includes faith, trust in God's word and God's character - take it up as a shield.
